answer.explanation: Request rq-109 ($2,600, sequencing core run 2 of 2) was held for the grant manager on grant R21AI182745. It failed the rule "Under the card limit, counting same-day purchases": together with rq-108 ($2,900), same person, category and day, the total is $5,500, over the limit. This matches the audit case at Southern Connecticut State Univ. (CT auditors, 2025), where same-day orders were split to stay under the $2,500 limit; only the grant manager can approve a purchase over the card limit.
